text.formatted: If the marilith dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.
text.plain: If the marilith dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

text.formatted: The marilith has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
text.plain: The marilith has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

text.formatted: The marilith can take one Reaction on every turn of combat.
text.plain: The marilith can take one Reaction on every turn of combat.

text.formatted: The marilith makes six Pact Blade attacks and uses Constrict.
text.plain: The marilith makes six Pact Blade attacks and uses Constrict.

text.formatted: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +10, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 10 (1d10 + 5) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.
text.plain: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

text.formatted: _Strength Saving Throw:_ DC 17, one Medium or smaller creature the marilith can see within 5 feet. _Failure:_ 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.
text.plain: Strength Saving Throw: DC 17, one Medium or smaller creature the marilith can see within 5 feet. Failure: 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

text.formatted: The marilith teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.
text.plain: The marilith teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

text.formatted: _Trigger:_ The marilith is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. _Response:_ The marilith adds 5 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.
text.plain: Trigger: The marilith is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The marilith adds 5 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.
